source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Search and filter condition text can contain non-ASCII values. Use AUTF8String across the IDL boundary and parse the UTF-8 data without lossy conversion, or saved search terms can change when reloaded.
title: Preserve UTF-8 in serialized search conditions
